text:
Amaya: Pushing a new mock for dark-mode graph treatments + token heatmap. Link: https://redwood.mock/local/dark-graph-v2.png — can folks quick-crit? :eyes:

Priya: Nice, overall tone feels calmer. First nit: the axis labels are ~3.5:1 contrast on my screen. Need 4.5:1 for normal text. Suggest darken label from #9AA3B2 -> #7F8B9A.

Jorge: Saw the image — agree with labels. Also the chart grid lines are currently using a faint drop shadow which creates a halo on OLED. Can we switch to a single hairline with alpha instead? Example CSS:``` .chart-grid { stroke: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); stroke-width: 1px; } ```

Zoe: For the token heatmap, current diverging teal->purple feels pretty but it's hard to parse magnitude. Propose a 4-step sequential palette (low->high) so people can quickly scan hotspots: #0F1724, #0B5E5E, #2CA58D, #8CF0D2. Also we should add a legend with discrete buckets (0-10, 10-50, 50-200, 200+).

Priya: Agree on discrete buckets for accessibility and tooltips. Also callout: the red used for error overlays is very close to the string color in code blocks. Suggest move error -> #FF6B6B and strings -> #9AD46E.

Amaya: Good call. On syntax theming: we want comments muted, keywords punchy, and numbers subtle. Current mock uses comments = #8A939B which reads fine. What about keyword color? We were experimenting with magenta but it clashes with charts. Maybe a slate-purple: #C98CF6?

Jorge: Slate-purple is nice but might vibrate on dark bg. I'd prefer a slightly desaturated purple: #A17ACB. Also we should reduce code block padding from 16px -> 12px to tighten layout.

DesignBot: Automated contrast check: background #0B0E11, primary text #E6EEF3 -> ratio 14.1:1 (good). Axis label suggestion (#7F8B9A) -> ratio 4.6:1 (passes). Token heatmap low step (#0F1724) -> ratio 8.9:1.

Zoe: One more data-viz nit: area fills under the line use a gradient that starts too bright near the axis baseline. Try flip the gradient so the baseline is darker to reduce perceived shimmer. Example:``` linearGradient: [{offset: 0, color: 'rgba(12,18,28,0.6)'}, {offset: 1, color: 'rgba(28,46,70,0.12)'}] ```

Priya: Also please add focus outlines for interactive legend items. On keyboard focus currently there's none. Use 2px solid #5AD1FF with 3px radius.

Amaya: Love these. Action items: Jorge — update CSS snippets (grid + code padding + keyword color). Zoe — generate a small demo with discrete heatmap legend and swapped gradient. Priya — run full contrast audit on the new palette. I'll synthesize and post an updated PNG by EOD.

Jorge: On it. Will push a tiny PR with CSS diff and a Storybook story so the theme vars are visible.

Zoe: I can make a quick Vega-lite sample for the heatmap to validate buckets.

Priya: If we land on Okabe-Ito friendly colors, please flag that in the PR description so I can verify colorblind scenarios.

Amaya: Thanks team! Small ask: can we avoid adding more neon pinks? My earlier magenta idea is vetoed :grimace: — trying to keep charts calm and readable.

DesignBot: Reminder: scheduled theme A/B starts next Tue 09:00 UTC. Add final theme token list to #eng-frontend for rollout planning.
